scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm start -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/tests backend/prisma frontend/src/app e2e && tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/prisma frontend/src docs scripts e2e *.json *.md
